attributes.board_name: Colorado State Board of Pharmacy (Division of Professions and Occupations)

rules.alternatives: No state-set hours: to renew the Colorado certification the technician must complete the continuing education and renewal requirements of, and keep active certification with, a Board-approved certifying organization (PTCB or the National Healthcareer Association).
rules.audit_note: Compliance audits after each certification period; keep CE records at least 4 years, with proof of active PTCB/NHA certification.
rules.notes: Colorado does not set its own CE hours for pharmacy technicians; the CE requirement is whatever the national certifying organization requires for recertification. Inactive certificants need no CE while inactive (C.R.S. § 12-280-117.5).
rules.rule_quote: Pharmacy Technicians must complete the continuing education and renewal requirements of, and maintain an active certification with, a certifying organization to renew their Colorado state certification.
